competitions.result: Runners-up — lost 2–1 to Arsenal after extra time at Wembley.
Third round — lost 2–0 away to Swindon Town.
Semi-final — lost 1–0 on aggregate to Leeds United, with a 1–0 defeat at Anfield followed by a 0–0 away draw.

overview: Liverpool finished fifth with 51 points for the second successive season. They conceded only 24 league goals, fewer than any other First Division side, and went unbeaten at Anfield in the league. Steve Heighway arrived from Skelmersdale United, with John Toshack joining from Cardiff City in November.

A 2–1 semi-final victory over Everton took Liverpool to Wembley, where they lost the FA Cup final 2–1 to Arsenal after extra time on 8 May. Heighway scored Liverpool’s goal, but his first season ended without silverware.

Alun Evans led the scoring with 15 goals in all competitions, including a hat-trick in the 3–0 home win over Bayern Munich. Liverpool won that Fairs Cup quarter-final 4–1 on aggregate before losing the semi-final to Leeds United by a single goal over two legs. Swindon Town had already knocked them out of the League Cup in the third round.

events.title: Evans scores three against Bayern
events.detail: Evans scored all three goals in the 3–0 Fairs Cup quarter-final first-leg victory at Anfield.

events.title: Everton beaten in the semi-final
events.detail: Liverpool won 2–1 at Old Trafford to reach the FA Cup final.

events.title: Extra-time defeat at Wembley
events.detail: Arsenal won the FA Cup final 2–1 after extra time. Steve Heighway scored for Liverpool.

researchNotes: Evans’s 15 goals are an all-competition total, independently corroborated by 11v11. Its appearance figures have discrepancies, so the key-player selection follows LFChistory’s season appearance ledger.
Whitham and Heighway are allocated to the incoming campaign. Keegan’s May 1971 signing is recorded under 1971–72, when he first played competitive football for Liverpool.
No fee or free-transfer label is asserted for Heighway: the transfer ledger’s asterisked “Free” entry needs qualification. Other uncorroborated fees are omitted.
